page_title: WER 0-3 FRE | Werder Bremen v Freiburg 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Timo Gerach is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Mio Backhaus to make a comfortable save.
90+1' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Philipp Lienhart is replaced by Anthony Jung (Freiburg).
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen).
89' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is coming onto the pitch as Junior Adamu cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' The game has come to an end for Patrick Osterhage. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Eren Dinkci (Freiburg).
83' Looks like Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
83' The attendance for today's match is 40500.
81' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.
78' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
77' Substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) on for Senne Lynen.
75' 0 - 3 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
73' Romano Schmid goes off the pitch and Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) comes on.
73' Horst Steffen has decided to make a change. Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) replaces Yukinari Sugawara.
71' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Timo Gerach and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

70' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Noah Atubolu, who pulls off a comfortable save!
69' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) replacing Vincenzo Grifo.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jan-Niklas Beste as he is replaced by Philipp Treu (Freiburg).
68' Isaac Schmidt picks out Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
67' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the left side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
60' Horst Steffen decides to make a substitution. Jens Stage will be replaced by Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen).
60' Substitution. Justin Njinmah is replaced by Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen).

59' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot inside the left post. Noah Atubolu anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
59' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
58' The Werder Bremen players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
58' Referee Timo Gerach makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Werder Bremen. Let’s see what happens!
54' 0 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Vincenzo Grifo finds Junior Adamu (Freiburg) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the middle of the goal. 0:2.
53' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
49' The referee shows a yellow card to Marco Grull (Werder Bremen). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Timo Gerach didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Half-chance! Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) plays a pass into the box, but Mio Backhaus reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Timo Gerach has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' None of the Werder Bremen players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

45+2' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
38' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
36' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
35' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
33' 0 - 1 Goal! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mio Backhaus into the top right corner.
33' It’s a PENALTY to Freiburg after the VAR review!
32' There's a break in play and referee Timo Gerach must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Freiburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
32' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area. Freiburg are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
30' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.

30' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Timo Gerach with no other option than to blow for a foul.
27' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
26' Freiburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
24' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
23' It looks like Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) saw red with that tackle. Timo Gerach won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
20' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) serves up a nice cross, but Noah Atubolu punches the ball away.
18' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) sprays a pass out to Junior Adamu, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
12' A short pass finds Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.

10' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Noah Atubolu is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
1' The first half has started.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Timo Gerach got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
